description: Public Transport Authority Rail Distance Measures (PTA-005) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Public Transport Authority. Distance measures along PTA-controlled railway lines, measured from established origin points. Used for locating assets along railway corridors, and providing a common frame of reference for locating points on railway lines where geographical data is not available. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Public Transport Authority. Its tags are pta, public, rail, transport. It offers 8 resource(s) in API ARCGIS SERVER MAP SERVICE, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
